title: GSE cardinality-conditioned circular slot transport readiness
purpose: Prove the zero-training mathematical, causal, symmetry and real-batch contract for a K-slot circular transport decoder that directly addresses the sealed multi-exit mode-loss and selected-bin residual mismatch.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training slot-transport readiness on C01-C08 Teacher and eight deterministic real rows; no optimizer, checkpoint, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated continuous best-method execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame LiDAR dataset.
Sealed Circular Exit Geometry Field Teacher.

worlds.fit: No fit; full metadata audit plus deterministic eight-row readiness only.
worlds.selection: No checkpoint, threshold or hyperparameter selection.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Audit all 188,126 references and run one deterministic eight-row batch covering 1-4 exits, wrap and invalid width; no resampling or fit.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin exit centers plus sub-bin residual, width mask/profile and existing axis/width/height/slope/curvature targets.
teacher.use: Readiness-only bijective slot assignment, soft two-bin continuous targets and matched geometry loss.
teacher.valid_mask: Width uses target width mask; profile and bearing use present exits; global geometry uses existing field masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C07/C08 inform the prior failure attribution but no model is trained or selected in this readiness.

methods.main: Five-frame circular encoder plus explicit 1-4 count and count-conditioned K azimuth slot distributions. Soft continuous circular targets and minimum permutation bijection match K required slots to K exits; circular resultant yields bearing/concentration and slot-pooled features yield geometry.
methods.baseline: Rejected single normalized intensity plus selected-bin residual, whose sealed attribution showed 3/4-exit mode loss and confidence failure.
methods.fallback: Any expressivity, duplicate gradient, concentration, rotation, slot permutation, causal or real finite-backward failure stops this decoder.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 188,126 observations, 396,913 exits and 1/2/3/4 counts 7,525/154,279/24,458/1,864.
acceptance.bijection: Correct one-to-one assignment loss below duplicate; duplicate has a negative gradient that promotes its missing target.
acceptance.symmetry: Synthetic and network rotation, slot permutation, batch permutation and repeat contracts pass at 3e-5.
acceptance.confidence: Sharp circular mass concentration >0.99 and uniform concentration <1e-5.
acceptance.real_batch: All outputs/losses/gradients finite on deterministic real 1-4 exit rows; five-frame path connected.

failure_policy: Fail closed without training or changing slot count, bins, matching, continuous target or thresholds.
retention: Retain summary, selected-row CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, environment, log, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full metadata audit plus one eight-row Torch forward/backward and symmetry passes
